message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"Multiple passages provide explicit, corroborated statements about Airbnb's revenue model, recognition timing, and agent/net presentation.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Airbnb generates substantially all of its revenue from facilitating guest stays at accommodations offered by hosts on the Airbnb platform","passage_rank":3,"quote":"generates substantially all of our revenue from facilitating guest stays at accommodations offered by hosts on the Airbnb platform."},{"requirement":"Airbnb generates revenue from service fees charged to hosts and guests for facilitating stays (fees are based on the booking value, excluding taxes)","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We calculate Airbnb service fees based on a percentage of the booking value, exclusive of taxes."},{"requirement":"The single performance obligation is the facilitation of a stay, which occurs upon the completion of a check-in event","passage_rank":3,"quote":"Our single performance obligation is identified as the facilitation of a stay, which occurs upon the completion of a check-in event."},{"requirement":"Revenue is recognized upon check-in (the performance obligation is satisfied at check-in)","passage_rank":3,"quote":"Revenue is recognized at a point in time when the performance obligation is satisfied upon check-in."},{"requirement":"Airbnb is presented as an agent and revenue is net of the service fees (not gross)","passage_rank":2,"quote":"The Company determined that it does not control the right to use the properties either before or after completion of its service. Accordingly, the Company has concluded that it is acting in an agent capacity and revenue is presented net reflecting the service fees received from guests and hosts to facilitate a stay."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
